task: Draft accessible alternative text for a bar chart on a fictional organization's website. The alt text must convey the chart type, purpose, and key values to a screen reader user who cannot see the image. Use only the supplied facts; observed year-over-year increases may be noted as a pattern, not a projection.

facts.text: The chart is a bar chart showing annual donations received by a fictional charitable trust in 2020, 2021, 2022, and 2023.
The chart has the title Donations Received 2020–2023.
The alt text replaces the chart for screen reader users and must be self-contained.
No forecast or causal analysis is included in the supplied packet.

forbidden_additions: An invented value not from the supplied figures.
A causation or projection claim for future years.
Alt text that only repeats the chart title without any data values.
preserve: Donations Received 2020–2023 as the chart title.
Self-contained description usable without the image.
